name: auth-failures
description: Count authentication failures and login errors in LMS/CMS logs.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND (textPayload=~"login_session" OR textPayload=~"authentication" OR jsonPayload.event="login_failed") AND (textPayload=~" 401 " OR textPayload=~" 403 " OR textPayload=~" 500 " OR jsonPayload.status>=400 OR jsonPayload.status_code>=400)
